column1: # Tools the Tauri bundler downloads (and caches in ~/.cache/tauri) to build an AppImage. Pinned here by SHA-256 (SYNC-09e, R-61/R-70):
# scripts/fetch-bundler-tools.sh installs exactly these bytes, or stops. Columns (tab separated):
# cache file name | source URL | SHA-256 of the download | patch applied by the bundler (none|appimage-magic) | SHA-256 of the cached file
# The linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk and -gstreamer scripts are embedded in the pinned @tauri-apps/cli, not downloaded.
# `appimage-magic` = the bundler zeroes bytes 8-10 of the AppImage (`dd if=/dev/zero bs=1 count=3 seek=8 conv=notrunc`), so the tool runs without FUSE.
